fusions.name: Close Report
fusions.desc: Fires a round at the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Scattershot
fusions.desc: Looses a wide spread of shot ahead of you, dealing 8 damage to everything caught in it. Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Loophole Post
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to set a shielded firing post beside you for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it fires on an enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage.

fusions.name: Counter-Shot
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a shot leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 5 lightning damage. Once every 6 seconds.
